en.askTitle: Enter your own salary, spending and accounts, and see whether pension savings, an ISA or cash is the better home for year-end money
en.runTitle: A Seoul office worker's year-end tax check: pension savings, ISA or cash before 31 December

fields.label: Tax year, age, residence and household status
fields.value: 2026 tax year, age 31, single, living alone in Seoul

fields.label: Gross salary, deductible insurance and withholding
fields.value: Total annual salary of KRW 62 million

fields.label: Existing pension contributions and account terms
fields.value: No pension savings or IRP contributions yet; an ISA opened in 2025 holding KRW 8 million

fields.label: Card spending by category
fields.value: About KRW 1.6 million a month on credit card and about KRW 400,000 on debit card and cash payments

fields.label: Lease, loan dates and repayments
fields.value: Jeonse officetel with a KRW 180 million deposit and a KRW 120 million bank loan

fields.label: Cash actually accessible and near-term needs

en.template: Build a Korean year-end tax and cash plan for {household}, {salary}, {pension}, {cards}, {lease}, and {cash}. Compare pension savings, IRP, ISA and keeping cash; separate tax reductions from refunds, check compatible deductions, and flag any proposal or unverified rule. Plan only; do not access accounts, contribute money or file a return.

phases.title: Research the 2026 rules, write the guide and have it independently checked
phases.note: Pension-account credit, card deduction, jeonse loan deduction and the ISA trade-off
phases.judgment: The check was done by someone who did not write the guide. The independent reviewer recomputed the money figures from the source notes without reading the author’s calculations, and found no mismatches in 25 checks. It also pushed back on labelling: the headline 13.2% rate was stated without a caveat although the local-tax add-on was unconfirmed. The author fixed those labels.

workers: Recomputed every money figure from the source notes without looking at the author’s calculations, and checked the guide's statute claims
